phase: candidate input construction before final intervention predictive scores
selection: All randomized physical exposure rows, retaining concurrent exposures and unavailable-role rows for audit; no target values enter selection.
environment_rule: 5*recorded_scenario+duration_group; unknown duration retained but not admissible for active search; scenario is a conditioning stratum.
current_random_flag: Cohort selector only, never a predictor or estimated propensity
scope: Observed random-exposure responses in the released cohort; no population causal effect, arbitrary interface effect or multistep counterfactual claim.

resource_budget.scope: Smoke/full timeout and startup reservations; not provider-enforced billing cap
